english.title: Keeper of animals fail to keep register in line with EC requirements (Wales)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 23(1) of the Sheep and Goats (Records, Identification and Movement) (Wales) Order 2015 and sections 73 and 75 Animal Health Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a keeper of animals
failed to keep register in format approved by competent authority and
keep it available at all times upon request for no less than 3 years
in line with requirements in Article 5(3) of Council Regulation (EC) No 21/2004

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The requirements of the register are contained within Article 5(3) of Council Regulation (EC) No 21/2004.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE STATEMENT OF FACTS..).

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale. Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
